content: Ndiirà ntɔn mudwa Yɛsu
Un'kyɔm a mampà màkɔ̈ɔ̈n ful bàfàbel Pak làsin tsütsü.
Amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàleŋà mudwa Yɛsu, wɛɛ ba bàweemà bɔɔmà a un'sɛŋ.
Yudas wà tsütsü muyälà Yɛsu
Apan, Satanà kàbilà u mpem a Yudas Iskaryɔt, umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel.
Yudas kàkyen akà amfum a angaŋ anà amfum a aleer a ndwà a Nzam ntɔn nde ukàyäm anà ba muyöb naa nde Yɛsu ayun'yälà aben.
Ba bàkäl kà un'sak, waa bàyilà naa ba bàyun'pà ngim.
Nde waa kàkyey. Sɛmà apan, nde kàleŋà ipöl aŋàbwaŋ muyälà Yɛsu kà unku, ntɔn baar banswà bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayöb.
Yɛsu kan'swaŋ muyilà isaa a Pak
Yàmɛnà naa ilä a mampà màkɔ̈ɔ̈n ful, ilä bàfàdwa in'tö a in'kɔk ntɔn Pak kyàkwe kya,
Yɛsu kàtöm Petɔlà anà Ywan, waa kaswɛŋ naa: « Làkyen kàlayilà ndyeel a Pak. »
Ba bun'fuul naa: « Ngye akwen naa bi la ikàyilà ken? »
Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Le, mpal làkàbilà bɛ u bul a kölàköl, bɛ làkàman mbuur mwɛy anà làbuuŋ a an'dà. Lun'läb tii u ndwà ukàbilà nde.
Bɛ làkàtɛn a ŋandwà abà: "Un'lɔɔŋ kan'tɛn a ngye naa: Làken suk in'dyà mɛ Pak anà alɔŋki amɛ?"
Waa nde ukàlaswaŋ, u ndwà adu, suk a kölàköl làŋalɔɔn ubwaŋàbwaŋ, ikal làkàyilà bɛ Pak kyakin. »
Ba waa bàkyen, bàmɛn ndaa yanswà asànaa kàtɛn Yɛsu, waa bàyilà isaa a Pak.
Udyà in'kyɛɛl
Taaŋ làkwe la, Yɛsu kàkäl u mɛsà anà antööm.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mɛ, mɛ kàkwen mbɔɔn mudyà Pak alà anà bɛ kusà muman mpay.
Lalan, mɛ ndandaa alàkyään naa mɛ in'fàsàdyà anki la tii ilä isàmɛnà mbuul a la uboo a Imwol a Nzam. »
Apan, nde kàwɛl kɔɔb, kàfuur an'tɔɔn, waa kàtɛn naa: « Làwɛl kɔɔb là, làkäb la bɛ a bɛ,
ntɔn mɛ alàkyään naa sɛmà apanà mɛ in'fàsànwà anki vin tii mpal isàyà Imwol a Nzam. »
Ungö apan, nde kàwɛl mampà, waa kàfuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam, kàtsül ma, kapɛ, waa kàtɛn naa: « Ayi ndür amɛ bàpɛ ntɔn bɛ. Làkyer abà ntɔn mukan'yɔbà. »
Ungö a udyà, nde kàwɛl kɔɔb, waa kàtɛn naa: « Lalà kɔɔb a un'tüüb akün kan'kyer bi unsà an'kil amɛ amiyàpää ntɔn bɛ.
Wɛɛ le, mbuur ayàyälà mɛ wà papà u mɛsà anà mɛɛ.
Ntɔn Mwan a mbuur wàmukyà asànaa bàtsül ya, wɛɛ ngyɛb akà mbuur kàmun'yälà! »
Apan, ba bàbulà mufufuul ba a ba naa uboo a ba nà ayàkyer undiir a tub awà.
Nà kan'söön?
Yàmɛnà naa ilä mwɛy alɔŋki bàsyeelà mbaaŋ ba a ba: ba bàkwen muyöb naa uboo a ba nà awà mbuur a kölàköl.
Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Amfum a in'sɛŋ bàkyer afandyaar, baar abye anà ikɔ̈b udu a ba bàfàleŋ naa babel baar aŋàbwaŋ.
Kà yubwaŋ anki bɛ mukyer abà, yubwaŋ naa mbuur a kölàköl uboo a bɛ ukäl umbɛy, wɛɛ mbuur akayaalà ukäl asànaa un'syääl.
Uboo a an'kyän abɛ, nà awà kölàköl? Mbuur kan'bwaay u mɛsà lɛɛ mbuur akapaa isaa? Kà mbuur kan'bwaay u mɛsà anki? Wɛɛ mɛ, mɛ uboo a bɛ in'wà asànaa un'syääl.
Bɛ lan'ndäär u ndür amɛ taaŋ lanswà an'man mɛ mpay.
Lalan, asànaa kan'pɛ Taaràmɛ Imwol, mɛ sye amàlapà kya:
Bɛ làsàdyà anà làsànwà u mɛsà anà mɛ, uboo a imwol amɛ, bɛ làsàbwaay udu a kir a imfum ntɔn mutsul nsaŋ a in'sɛŋ a Isàlɛl myàkwem aŋiyweel. »
Yɛsu kan'kyään ntöön a Petɔlà
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàtɛn a Simɔn Petɔlà naa: « Simɔn, Simɔn! Le, Satanà kàkyer alɔm naa nde kàlasɛk asànaa bàfàsɛk mbɛŋ mukaab ya anà isɛrà.
Wɛɛ mɛ kàyamà ntɔn ngye, ntɔn làkwikilà angye làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà. Wɛɛ ngye, ilä asyefurà ngye akà mɛ, pà atɔŋ angye ngwal. »
Simɔn kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mwol, mɛ an'kyey mukyà anà ngye, itàkal u bɔlokà, itàkal kà ukwà. »
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: « Simɔn, mɛ ndandaa akyään, ŋabawà, kusà nkɔɔ mubel, ngye akyer an'tɔn mukan'yöb mbalà tär. »
Ngim, ngɔɔr anà kɔm
Ungö apan, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Taaŋ kàlatöm mɛ ukɔɔn ngim, ngɔɔr anà an'sàbar, nkye we anà undiir kàlakɔ̈ɔ̈n? » Ba waa bàfuur naa: « Akà undiir. »
Apan, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Wɛɛ papanà, isàkal naa mbuur we anà ngim, uwɛl ya, isàkal sye naa mbuur we anà ngɔɔr, uwɛl wa, isàkal naa mbuur kɔm latɛy, uyälà inkur ande, usöm làmwɛy.
Ntɔn mɛ alàkyään naa yubwaŋ naa undiir aŋàsɔn wà ukwe amu mɛ: "Nde bun'täŋ uboo a adwää baar." »
Waa ba bàtɛn naa: « Mwol, le an'kɔm mɔ̈ɔ̈l amà. » Yɛsu kafuur naa: « Man'kwo! »
Yɛsu kan'kàyamà u mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlive
Yàmɛnà naa Yɛsu kàkyer atoo, waa kàkyen u mbwo a mɔŋ a in'te a ɔlive asànaa ifà ande. Alɔŋki waa bun'läb.
Mpal kàtöl nde kà ikal akin, nde kaswɛŋ naa: « Làyamà, ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u ndɛb. »
Wɛɛ nde, nde kàkyen ukɔl a ba kà isii a bwɛl ufàkàbwà un'kul awà ban'lom, kàbü an'köm, waa kàyamà
abà: « Ɔɔ Taa, kya ngye asàkwen, lwom kɔɔb là tsütsü apà mɛ! Wɛɛ taaŋ lanswà, wɛy bàkäl ukwen angye, kà bàmɛ anki. » [
Apan, un'kyeey mwɛy waa kàyamɛnà akà nde ntɔn mukun'pà ngwal.
Yàmɛnà naa nkyän yàkyer un'kaar, nde kàfàyamà nswɛy nswɛy, kyaŋ a ndür ande waa làbulà asànaa bin'kul a an'kil byàbwee u mɛɛn. ]
Ungö a ngyamàkà ayi, nde waa kàmbarà, kàsin tsütsü apà alɔŋki ande, nde kamɛn bàkyàbɔ̈ɔ̈n a ngyɛb.
Apan, nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Ntɔn nkye lan'bɔ̈ɔ̈n bɛ? Làmbarà! Làyamà ntɔn bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n abwà u ndɛb. »
Nköör a Yɛsu
Nde kàkäl mutɛn, mpal kàkɔlà un'kàbɔ a baar. Mbuur bàfabeelà Yudas, umwɛy uboo a Bàkwem Aŋiyweel, kàkäl kusà a ba. Nde kàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu ntɔn mukundüür.
Waa Yɛsu kàtɛn a nde naa: « Yudas, ngye Mwan a mbuur un'yälà a ndüür? »
Mpal bàmɛn baar bàkäl a Yɛsu naa ndaa yan'täy, ba bun'fuul naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, nkye bi isyääl an'kɔm abi ntɔn munwan? »
Utaaŋ nsil alan, umwɛy uboo a ba kàkäm un'syääl a undweer a angaŋ mwɛy kɔm, waa kun'ywaŋ tsü a ibaal.
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Làwɛy, yan'kwo! » Apan, nde kàbä tsü a mbuur awun, waa kun'kɔɔr.
Apan, Yɛsu kàtɛn a amfum a angaŋ, a an'kaptɛn a ndwà a Nzam anà andwer a baar bàyi ntɔn mukun'kɔr: « Nkye mɛ in'wà un'dwää a baar waa bɛ làyi anà an'kɔm anà nköl?
Mɛ kàkälà anà bɛ ilä byanswà u ndwà a Nzam, wɛ akà mbuur kan'bä anki. Apanà là taaŋ abɛ anà ngwal a mpib. »
Petɔlà kan'tɔn Yɛsu
Apan ba bun'te mpi, waa bun'syen u ndwà a amfum a angaŋ. Petɔlà kàyilabà ukwɛl.
Baar bàyöbà mbaa uboo a làpaŋ. Petɔlà kàbwaayà uboo a baar bàkäl ukɔl a ya.
Un'syääl mwɛy wà un'kaar kun'mɛn tsütsü a ba, laa kun'syebà u kyɛɛy a mbaa, waa kàtɛn naa: « Le, mbuur wà sye kàkäl anà nde. »
Wɛɛ nde kàkyer un'tɔn, waa kàtɛn naa: « Un'kaar wà, mɛ nde un'yöb anki. »
Ungö a taaŋ ikikye, mbuur asin kàmɛn nde Petɔlà, kàtɛn a nde naa: « Ngye sye awà umwɛy uboo a baar bà! » Petɔlà naa: « Mbuur wà, mɛ mwo watɛy! »
Tsütsü ungö a taaŋ làmwɛy, mbuur asin waa ufàtɛn a ngwal yanswà: « Ndandaa, mbuur wunà kàkäl anà nde ntɔn nde wà un'nsi Ngalilɛ. »
Petɔlà kàfuur naa: « Mbuur wà, mɛ in'yöb anki naa ngye nkye akwen mutɛn. » Taaŋ nsil alan, nde kàkäl anki aŋàtàmay mutɛn, nkɔɔ waa kàbel.
Mwol kàbulà nde, waa kàler Petɔlà. Apan Petɔlà kàyɔbà ndaa kun'kyään Mwol: « Kusà nkɔɔ mutàbel ŋàbawà, ngye ayan'tɔn mbalà tär! »
Apan laa kàtoo nde, waa kàlel ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Yɛsu bàmuto anà bàmudwa
Baar bàkäl muler Yɛsu bàkyer akun'sɛɛ anà kun'dübà.
Ba bun'bäämà ipfɛy u mii, waa bun'fuulà naa: « Le! Tà ngɔɔm! Ikyään nà kàmadwa! »
Laa bun'töö ba in'tswe asin myà ifà ifà.
Yɛsu u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl
Mpal làsɛnà taaŋ, nkööŋ a andweer a un'sɛŋ, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàkyer aköŋ, waa bun'syɛn u làbay a nsaŋ a kölàköl,
waa bàtɛn naa: « Isàkal naa ngye, ngye awà Klistɔ, ikyään. » Yɛsu kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mɛ in'sàlakyään, bɛ làyàkyey anki,
mɛ in'sàlafuul, bɛ làyan'fuur anki.
Wɛɛ, sɛmà apanà, Mwan a mbuur ayàkal wàŋàbwaay u kɔɔ a ibaal a ngwal a Nzam. »
Apan ba banswà bàtɛn naa: « Iswaŋà naa ngye awà Mwan a Nzam! » Yɛsu kàtɛn naa: « Bɛ ŋakwo lan'tɛn naa mɛ in'wà nde. »
Apan, ba bàtɛn naa: « Bi mfun a imbäl ifàkal anki. Bi ŋakwo kan'wem u mun ande. »
